Transit Departure Board

Next departures, big and glanceable. Real-time for BART out of the box; a link-out directory for other agencies; and a slot for any agency that publishes a JSON feed.

Live estimated departures from BART's public API. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds while this tab is visible.
Using BART's shared public key — get your free key.
Most agencies don't send the CORS headers a single HTML file needs, so this page can't read their feeds directly — but the agency's own live board works everywhere. Save yours for one-click access.
Advanced: direct JSON feed
If your agency offers a CORS-open JSON endpoint — or you run the optional suite relay — paste it here. The board makes a best effort to read common shapes (GTFS-realtime-as-JSON, plain departure arrays), and shows the raw JSON if it can't. Protobuf GTFS-realtime won't work directly.
